faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Everything about how a DeFi Tanda actually works, in plain language.

whatIsTanda.a: A tanda (also called a ROSCA, susu, or hui) is a rotating savings circle. A fixed group of people each contribute the same amount every cycle, and the whole pot goes to one member per cycle until everyone has received it once. DeFi Tanda runs this on the XRP Ledger so contributions, payouts, and collateral are all verifiable on-chain instead of relying on trust in whoever's holding the cash.

howRotationWorks.q: How does the payout rotation work?
howRotationWorks.a: When a tanda fills up, every member is assigned a payout slot (in join order, or shuffled if the organizer chose random order). Each cycle, every member except that cycle's recipient sends their contribution directly to the recipient's wallet. Once everyone's cycle payment is confirmed, the tanda automatically advances to the next cycle. This repeats until every member has been the recipient exactly once, at which point the tanda is COMPLETED.

whichChain.q: Which blockchain and token does this use?
whichChain.a: Tandas currently run on the XRP Ledger, using either XRP or RLUSD (a USD-backed stablecoin) as the contribution token. Everything — collateral, cycle payments, refunds — is a real on-chain XRPL transaction.

howToCreate.q: How do I create a tanda?
howToCreate.a: From the app, choose "Create Tanda," pick your chain/token, group size, contribution amount, cycle length, and payout order (fixed by join order, or random). A dedicated escrow wallet is created for the pod. On live (mainnet), there's a small XRP creation fee paid to the platform treasury; on testnet it's free.

howToJoin.q: How do I join a tanda?
howToJoin.a: Open the pod and tap Join. Your wallet (Xaman) will prompt you to send the collateral amount to the pod's escrow wallet. Once that payment is confirmed on-chain, you're added as a member. When the group fills up, the tanda activates and cycle 1 begins.

whyCollateral.q: Why do I have to pay 2× the contribution amount to join?
whyCollateral.a: Collateral protects the rest of the group. If you ever miss a cycle payment, your collateral covers it instead of leaving that cycle's recipient short. You get back whatever's left of your collateral once the tanda completes (or immediately, if the pod is cancelled before it fills).

howToPay.q: How do I pay each cycle?
howToPay.a: Go to the pod and tap Pay. If you're not this cycle's recipient, your wallet will prompt you to send your contribution directly to whoever is. If you ARE this cycle's recipient, there's nothing to send — you just receive everyone else's contributions. Every payment is verified on-chain before it's recorded, so you never need to worry about "did it go through."

whatIsDefault.q: What happens if I miss a payment (default)?
whatIsDefault.a:
Every day, the platform automatically checks for members who haven't paid the current cycle in time. If you've missed the window, 1× your contribution amount is automatically taken from your collateral and sent to that cycle's recipient on your behalf — so the recipient still gets paid in full, no matter what. You're then marked DEFAULTED and removed from the payment rotation for the rest of the tanda: you won't be asked to pay future cycles, and you won't receive a payout slot if you don't already have one.

You keep whatever's left of your collateral (originally 2× your contribution — 1× gets used to cover the missed cycle, so 1× remains) and can claim it back once the tanda completes.

whyCantIPay.q: Why is there no Pay button after I've defaulted?
whyCantIPay.a: Once you're marked DEFAULTED, you're no longer part of the cycle rotation — your missed payment was already covered by your own collateral, so there's nothing left to pay. Showing a Pay button that could only ever fail would just be confusing, so the app shows your defaulted status instead.

howToClaimBack.q: How and when do I get my collateral back?
howToClaimBack.a: Once a tanda reaches COMPLETED (everyone has received their payout) — or if it's CANCELLED or EXPIRED before it ever filled — every member can claim their remaining collateral back from the pod page. If you never defaulted, that's the full 2× your contribution. If you did default once, it's whatever was left after that single deduction.

isItSafe.q: Is my money safe? How does verification work?
isItSafe.a: Every contribution, collateral deposit, and refund is a real XRPL transaction, and the backend independently verifies each one on-chain — checking the sender, recipient, amount, and currency — before crediting anything or updating a pod's status. Nothing is taken on trust from what a browser claims happened. Pod escrow wallet keys are encrypted at rest and only ever used server-side to sign the specific payout/refund/slash a pod's rules call for.

fees.q: What fees does the platform charge?
fees.a: Creating a live (mainnet) tanda has a small flat XRP creation fee paid once to the platform treasury. There are no per-cycle or per-payment fees beyond the XRPL network's own transaction fee (a fraction of a cent). Testnet tandas are free.

tanda.title: What is a Tanda?
tanda.p1: A Tanda is a community savings circle. A group of people agree to each put in the same amount every week — and every week, one person takes home the whole pot. It rotates until everyone has received their payout.
tanda.p2: No interest. No middleman. No profit. Just a group of people helping each other save and get ahead — the way communities have done it for centuries.
tanda.p3: You might know it as an Osusu, Hui, Stokvel, Chit Fund, or Arisan — same idea, every culture has one.
tanda.p4: The problem? When the organizer disappears, or someone stops paying after getting their payout. DeFi Tanda fixes that with a smart contract — code nobody can override, not even us.

how.title: How it works
how.sub: Three steps. Works with your wallet or card.
how.step1: The organizer sets up a tanda — group size, weekly amount, and duration. Members join with a refundable security deposit you can claim back once the tanda completes.
how.step2: Pay your share weekly, biweekly, or monthly — connect Xaman and pay directly from your wallet. Card and bank transfer support is coming soon.
how.step3: When your turn comes, the full pot lands in your wallet automatically. Early slot = interest-free loan. Late slot = disciplined savings plan.

xrp.title: Why XRP?
xrp.sub: The ledger your tanda's collateral runs on — where it came from, and why it's built to last.
xrp.h1: XRP launched in 2012, created by Ripple's founders as a faster, greener alternative to Bitcoin's proof-of-work mining. The entire 100 billion XRP supply was created at launch — there's no ongoing mining.
xrp.h2: The XRP Ledger (XRPL) settles transactions in 3–5 seconds for a fraction of a cent using a consensus protocol instead of mining — built from day one for real-world payments, not speculation.
xrp.h3: In 2024, Ripple launched RLUSD, a fully-reserved USD stablecoin issued directly on the XRPL — bringing regulated, dollar-stable liquidity onto the same ledger tandas already run on.
xrp.h4: Over a decade later, XRPL has processed billions of transactions with 99.99%+ uptime and is used by banks and payment providers worldwide for cross-border settlement — the same infrastructure your tanda's collateral runs on.

utility.title: Built for real payments
utility.body: Unlike purely speculative assets, XRP was designed to move value across borders instantly — the exact problem tandas solve for families sending money home.

speed.title: Fast & nearly free
speed.body: Transactions settle in 3–5 seconds for a fraction of a cent, regardless of network congestion — costs that don't spike the way other chains' can.

supply.title: Fixed, transparent supply
supply.body: All 100 billion XRP were created at launch — no mining, no inflation. A small fee is destroyed with every transaction, making supply slightly deflationary over time.

adoption.title: Growing institutional use
adoption.body: Banks and payment providers use XRPL for cross-border settlement, and Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is expanding real-world dollar liquidity directly on the ledger.

xrp.disclaimer: This is educational information, not financial advice. Cryptocurrency prices are volatile and can go down as well as up — only contribute what you can afford.

timeline.label: Our Journey
timeline.heading: From a napkin to the blockchain.
timeline.sub: Four years of building the future of community savings — one cycle at a time.
timeline.today_title: Testnet live. Fenbushi meeting. Ready to launch.
timeline.today_body: Full app running on XRPL devnet. Trilingual. Raising $1M seed.
timeline.y2022_body: Over tacos in Pilsen, one question kept coming up: why does grandma's tanda still run on paper and trust? The concept for DeFi Tanda is sketched on a napkin at a kitchen table.
timeline.y2023a_body: The name DeFi Tanda is chosen. The logo, the brand blue, the first Figma mocks. We wanted it to feel trustworthy, modern — something grandma and her grandkids would both use.
timeline.y2023b_body: First Solidity prototype deployed to Hardhat local. A real tanda lifecycle — create, join, pay, payout — running in code for the first time. Ugly but it worked.
timeline.y2023c_body: Discovered XRP Ledger: 3-second settlement, $0.001 fees, built for cross-border payments. It was purpose-built for tandas. We rebuilt everything on XRPL overnight.
timeline.y2024a_body: React frontend live. Xaman wallet integration working. First end-to-end tanda flow on XRPL devnet — a real person joined, paid, and received a payout from code, not a handshake.
timeline.y2024b_body: Designed the collateral enforcement system: 2× deposit locked on-chain, slashable if you default. Added RLUSD support — members can save and receive in a dollar-pegged stablecoin.
timeline.y2024c_body: Full Spanish localization shipped. Every screen, every error, every CTA — in the language our community actually speaks at home.
timeline.y2025a_body: Supabase database, Netlify serverless functions, daily cron job for overdue enforcement. A real system — not a demo. Admin panel for pod management and collateral release.
timeline.y2025b_body: Double-payment prevention, self-payment detection, missed-payment slash logic, multi-chain explorer links. Every edge case a tanda could hit — handled.
timeline.f2026a_body: XRPL mainnet with real funds. First 50 tanda groups onboarded in Chicago — Pilsen, Little Village, Chinatown. Fiat on-ramp via debit card. Ambassador program live.
timeline.f2026b_body: Idle collateral starts earning 4–8% APY via XRPL Vaults (XLS-66d). Capital protected. Your tanda saves together and earns together while it runs.
timeline.f2026c_body: iOS and Android app launch. Yield Tanda Phase 2: AMM liquidity strategy via XLS-30 for 5–15% APY. 1,000 active tanda groups. LA and Miami expansion.
timeline.f2027a_body: Full push into Chinese diaspora markets — Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan. The Hui goes on-chain. Mandarin-first onboarding, local ambassador network, Fenbushi distribution.
timeline.f2027b_body: Additional chain deployments. On-chain reputation passport — your payment history becomes a portable credit score. B2B API for credit unions and community banks.
timeline.f2028_body: DeFi Tanda becomes infrastructure. 100,000 active members. $50M+ TVL. DAO governance. Any community, any chain, any currency — one protocol.
